entry.name: rnbo_delay~
entry.description: Delay a signal by a specified number of samples.

arguments.name: maxsize
arguments.description: Set maximum delay size in samples. This determines the amount of memory allocated to the delay line so it is advisable to use the smallest value needed. Note that this can be set using the samplerate or vectorsize operators to account for various audio settings. For example,will create a 2 second delay line regardless of the samplerate of the audio card.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.digest: Delay time (samples or any time unit)
arguments.description: The amount of time in samples to delay the incoming signal before output. This value can be up to the maximum size defined byor. If defined as an object-box attribute, time units can also be used.

arguments.name: ramp
arguments.digest: crossfade time between different delay times (ms)
arguments.description: The time in milliseconds to crossfade between signals when the delay time value is changed (default = 50).
